title: IBM's 2026 CAIO Study: Accountability Without Decision Rights
description: IBM's 2026 CAIO study: only 18% of 1,667 AI leaders fully control AI investment, and 61% say decision rights are clear. What it means for agent-written code.
og_headline: IBM's 2026 CAIO Study on Decision Rights
og_alt: IBM's 2026 CAIO Study: chief AI officers are accountable for AI outcomes, while authority over the architectural decisions coding agents follow sits elsewhere

reciprocal.desc: A separate IBM study of 1,667 AI leaders: only 18% fully control AI investment, and 61% say decision rights are clear. What that means for agent-written code.
Why AI adoption numbers cannot show a CAIO whether the architecture held, and five measures an engineering team can report instead.
IBM's CAIO study finds accountability without authority. In software, that gap sits in the architectural decisions coding agents follow.
